_source: KE Workbench/tools/peo-buyer-personas.html (window.JOB_STUDIES), extracted 2026-10-20. Outcome tuple: [statement, unit, direction, target, baseline (null = not yet measured), metric card, measurement source].

admin.title: Client Admin job study: buying and adopting a PEO (prospect side)
admin.scope: Prospect companies with 5–150 employees evaluating a PEO; jobs the Client Admin performs from first enquiry to first PEO payroll.

jobs.name: Decide whether a PEO is the right way to run HR for our company
jobs.statement: Decide, with evidence the owners will accept, whether moving HR, payroll and benefits to a PEO lowers our cost and risk.

steps.name: Understand what a PEO takes off my plate
steps.service: Discover brief (Brief Assembler, Client Admin template)
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes to understand which HR, payroll, benefits and compliance tasks the PEO would take over
Minimize the likelihood of misunderstanding which tasks stay with our company
Maximize the share of our current HR tasks matched to a named PEO service

steps.name: Confirm we fit (size, industry, states)
steps.service: Fit check (federated query over eligibility rules)
outcomes: Minimize the number of steps it takes to confirm we are eligible
Minimize the likelihood of learning about an industry or state exclusion after a quote is issued
Minimize the time it takes to see which of our states and worksites are covered

steps.name: Compare total cost against our current stack
outcomes: Minimize the time from first cost question to a binding quote
Minimize the likelihood that the signed price differs from the quoted price
Maximize the share of cost lines that show their source and assumptions

steps.name: See the co-employment split before signing
outcomes: Maximize the share of proposal sessions that end with no follow-up question about who does what
Minimize the number of state-specific responsibilities missing from the allocation
Minimize the number of contract redline rounds

steps.name: Get sign-off from owners and finance
outcomes: Maximize the share of first drafts the owners approve without changes
Minimize the time from proposal to signed decision
Maximize the share of decision packages that state the risk the PEO removes

steps.name: Move payroll without a missed paycheck
outcomes: Minimize payroll errors in the first PEO payroll
Minimize the number of employees paid late in the first PEO payroll
Minimize the time it takes to reconcile the first PEO payroll against our last payroll register

jobs.name: Control the total cost of employing our workforce
jobs.statement: Know and predict what employing our people really costs, before and after the switch.

steps.name: Establish our current all-in cost per employee
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes to assemble our current all-in cost (payroll fees, benefits, workers’ comp, SUTA, broker fees)
Minimize the likelihood of leaving a cost category out of the baseline
Minimize the variance between our baseline and what we actually paid last year

steps.name: Project cost as headcount grows
steps.service: Growth scenario (cost model rerun, BEN-001 ACA check)
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes to see cost at a different headcount
Minimize the likelihood of crossing a regulatory threshold (such as ACA 50 FTE) without warning
Maximize the accuracy of projected first-year cost

steps.name: Provide clean census data for quoting
outcomes: Minimize the share of census uploads that fail validation
Minimize the time it takes to fix a rejected census
Minimize the amount of employee personal data shared beyond what quoting needs

steps.name: Budget for the first year after go-live
outcomes: Minimize the difference between the budgeted and invoiced amount in the first quarter
Minimize the time it takes to explain an invoice line to finance
Minimize the likelihood of an unexpected fee in the first year

jobs.name: Keep the business protected from employer liability
jobs.statement: Be certain which employer obligations we keep and which the PEO takes, and that nothing falls between us.

steps.name: Inventory the employer liabilities we carry today
steps.service: Liability inventory brief (shared with HR Specialist)
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes to list our current employer liabilities (tax filings, workers’ comp, EPLI, benefits)
Minimize the likelihood of missing an open liability (such as an unresolved claim or tax notice)
Maximize the share of liabilities linked to the rule or contract that creates them

steps.name: Confirm which liabilities move under co-employment
outcomes: Maximize the share of liabilities with a named owner (us, PEO or shared)
Minimize the number of liabilities described differently in the brief and the contract
Minimize the time it takes to get counsel comfortable with the allocation

steps.name: Confirm tax accounts and filings transfer correctly
outcomes: Minimize the number of tax notices received in the first two quarters
Minimize the time it takes to confirm each state account has transferred
Minimize double or missed filings in the transition quarter

steps.name: Protect employee data shared during the sale
outcomes: Minimize the number of people outside the deal team who can see our census
Minimize the time it takes to confirm where our data is stored and who can access it
Maximize the share of shared documents carrying an access label

hr.title: HR Specialist job study: keeping people compliant and covered through a PEO move (prospect side)
hr.scope: HR generalists or HR leads at prospects with 5–150 employees; jobs performed from the first risk question to the first PEO benefits month.

jobs.name: Make sure the move to a PEO leaves us compliant and our people covered
jobs.statement: Confirm, before and through the switch, that every compliance obligation is met and no employee loses coverage.

steps.name: Find where we carry compliance risk today
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes to see where we carry compliance risk
Maximize the share of risk items that cite a rule or regulator
Minimize the likelihood of missing a risk area (I-9, leave, postings, wage and hour)

steps.name: Check coverage for every state we hire in
steps.service: State coverage check (SSOT rules by jurisdiction)
outcomes: Maximize the share of hiring states assessed
Minimize the time it takes to resolve a remote employee’s jurisdiction
Minimize the time it takes to learn of a rule change in a hiring state

steps.name: Compare benefit plans employees will see
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes to compare current plans with PEO plans
Maximize the share of employees whose per-paycheck cost change is shown
Minimize the share of employees whose current doctors fall out of network

steps.name: Map our handbook to PEO policy
outcomes: Minimize the share of handbook policies left unmapped
Minimize the time it takes to map the handbook
Minimize the number of conflicts between our policies and PEO policy left open at signing

steps.name: Show leadership the risk we remove
steps.service: Risk brief linked into the owner decision package
outcomes: Maximize the share of decisions with a risk brief attached
Maximize the share of risk reduction stated in dollars or penalties avoided
Minimize the time it takes to prepare the leadership risk summary

steps.name: Re-enroll employees with no coverage gap
outcomes: Minimize the number of employees with a coverage gap
Maximize the share of employees who finish enrollment by the deadline

jobs.name: Keep employees informed and confident through the change
jobs.statement: Help employees understand what changes for them, when, and who to ask.

steps.name: Plan employee communications
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes to produce the change announcement and FAQ
Maximize the share of employees reached in their preferred language
Minimize the likelihood of announcing a date that later changes

steps.name: Answer employee questions during the switch
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes an employee to get a correct answer
Minimize the number of questions HR has to answer personally
Minimize the share of answers later found to be wrong

steps.name: Track enrollment progress
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes to see who has not enrolled
Minimize the number of manual reminders HR sends
Maximize the share of waivers recorded with a reason

steps.name: Gauge employee sentiment after the first payroll
outcomes: Maximize the share of employees who say the change went smoothly
Minimize the time it takes to spot a widespread problem
Minimize voluntary turnover attributed to the switch

jobs.name: Keep HR records and policies intact through the transition
jobs.statement: Move every record, balance and required notice without loss or exposure.

steps.name: Inventory the HR records and data to move
outcomes: Minimize the time it takes to list every record type to move (personnel files, I-9s, PTO, benefits elections)
Minimize the likelihood of leaving a required record type off the list
Maximize the share of record types with a retention rule attached

steps.name: Transfer records securely
outcomes: Minimize the number of records exposed to people who should not see them
Minimize the time it takes to transfer all records
Minimize the share of records that fail to load

steps.name: Carry over leave and PTO balances
outcomes: Minimize the number of employees whose balance is wrong after conversion
Minimize the time it takes to reconcile balances
Minimize the likelihood of a state leave rule being applied incorrectly after conversion

steps.name: Keep required postings and notices current
outcomes: Maximize the share of worksites and remote employees with current required notices
Minimize the time between a notice change and its delivery to employees
Minimize the number of jurisdictions without a confirmed posting owner
